english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 8(3)(b) and 9 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Aldermaston Byelaws 2010 and section 17(2) of the Military Lands Act 1892.

rode a bicycle / drove a vehicle

at AWE Burghfield

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 6 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Burghfield Byelaws 2010 provides that subject to the provisions of these byelaws, members of the public are permitted to use all parts of the Controlled Areas not specially enclosed or entry to which is not shown by signs or fences as being prohibited or restricted, for any lawful purpose at all times when the Controlled Areas are not being used for the military purpose for which they are appropriated.
(ii) Byelaw 10 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Burghfield Byelaws 2010 provides that these byelaws shall not apply to anything done (a) by a lawful user in connection with the discharge of his functions; or (b) by a person acting under and in accordance with any permission given in writing by the Appointed Person.
(iii) Byelaw 12 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Burghfield Byelaws 2010 provides that (a) the Appointed Person; (b) any officer, warrant officer, or non-commissioned officer in uniform and acting under the instructions of the Appointed Person; and (c) any other Crown servant authorised in writing by the Appointed Person are authorised to remove from the Protected Areas and Controlled Areas and to take into custody without warrant any person committing an offence against these byelaws and to remove any vehicle, aircraft, animal or thing in contravention of these byelaws from the Protected Area.
